description: Search indexed YouTube and podcast transcripts. Full transcripts, mentions, momentum, and sponsors.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <key>. An arc_sk_ account key from arcmira.com, or an arc_tk_ trial key minted with POST https://api.arcmira.com/v1/trial-keys (no login). Omit it and the host signs you in through OAuth.
